_comment: Hand-written BibTeX for publications no metadata service can resolve, keyed
'<section-id>|<entry-number>' like abstracts.json. Read by tools/build_bibtex.py;
an override always wins over the network, so this is also the place to correct a
publisher record that is wrong. The cite key here is ignored and regenerated.
Keys are entry NUMBERS, which move when a section is renumbered: these two were
written when VISHN was |35 and epiDAMIK was |27, and silently landed on unrelated
papers once conference-papers lost two entries. build_bibtex.py now checks each
override's title against the entry it lands on and refuses a mismatch, so a
renumber fails loudly. Re-run it after moving entries around.
conference-papers|33 (ANNSIM 2024): DOI 10.22360/ANNSIM.2024.HM.193 was never
deposited with the handle system, so doi.org, Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic
Scholar all return not-found, even though the ACM page it links to is live. Fields
transcribed from the CV citation; co-author's full first name from mentoring.html.
Delete this entry if SCS/ACM ever registers the DOI.
conference-papers|25 (epiDAMIK 5.0 @ KDD 2022): workshop papers get no DOI, and
OpenReview's API is behind a bot challenge. Authors and venue taken from the
workshop programme at epidamik.github.io/2022/program.html, which spells the site
owner 'Venkataramanan'; corrected here to the spelling he uses himself.
tech-reports|3 (IPM Innovation Lab, 2017): a USAID-funded technical report, never
assigned a DOI. Every field below is transcribed from the report's own Contributors
page, read from the archived PDF the entry now links to. Its original host,
ipmil.cired.vt.edu, no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN), so the Wayback capture is the
only working source.
tech-reports|17 (FluSight categorical trend evaluation, medRxiv 2026): posted
2026-09-02 under the new openRxiv prefix 10.64898; doi.org still returns 404, so
no service can resolve it yet. Title, authors and date transcribed from the
medRxiv API record and the paper's own author list. Delete this entry once the
DOI registers and build_bibtex.py can fetch it.
conference-papers|39 (ICML 2026): the entry now links to the ICML virtual poster
page, which carries no DOI and no metadata service can resolve, so the record is
transcribed from the arXiv preprint (2602.00299) with the venue corrected to the
proceedings. Replace it with the fetched record once PMLR publishes the volume and
the paper has a real DOI.
